videos.title: Married... With Children
videos.overview: Al and Peggy go over to watch a video at Marcy and Jefferson's house and proceed to take over the place.

videos.title: Married... With Children
videos.overview: Al Bundy's childhood pal, Charlie Verducci, and the guy's dim-witted son Vinnie attend a high society fundraiser in this pilot for the short-lived TV series, 'Top of the Heap.'

videos.title: Married... With Children
videos.overview: Al cannot afford to buy an air conditioner for the hot summer. After an attempt to install an old experimental model, (which results in a neighborhood blackout) Al moves his family into the local supermarket.

videos.title: Married... With Children
videos.overview: The Bundys and Darcys shop 'til they drop to see who will win $1000 in groceries. Needless to say, Marquis of Queensbury rules will not apply.

videos.title: Married... With Children
videos.overview: While on their way to Los Angeles for a "Shoe Convention," the Bundy's car breaks down in the small town of Lucifer, New Mexico where they meet an old prospector who gives them a map to an old gold mine in the area in exchange for their car.

videos.title: Married... With Children
videos.overview: Al, Peggy, Kelly, Bud, Jefferson, and Marcy find the gold mine in the desert. Al discovers the first gold nugget and everyone but the feeble-minded Kelly winds up with a bag full of gold.

videos.title: Married... With Children
videos.overview: A man offers the Bundy's $10,000 if Buck will breed with his champion dog, Lady Bird. So, Al has to coach Buck into knowing the varieties of breeding with other dogs the proper way.

videos.title: Married... With Children
videos.overview: Marcy and Jefferson announce that they are expecting a baby, sending Al into pearls of laughter saying that it's the end of Jefferson's life, until Peggy announces the same.

videos.title: Married... With Children
videos.overview: Peggy and Marcy's constant demands for belly rubbing and expensive baby accessories drive Al crazy, prompting him to make a run for it.

videos.title: Married... With Children
videos.overview: When Al unearths his father's old hammer, he decides to turn the garage into his own private room to escape his pregnant wife.

videos.title: Married... With Children
videos.overview: Kelly earns a quick $1,000 at hustling pool to buy a gown for the local Miss Cheese competition, and a suspicious Al is out for blood, mistakenly thinking that Kelly is into prostitution.

videos.title: Married... With Children
videos.overview: While Peggy is away helping Marcy recover her precious childhood belongings that Jefferson auctioned off and gambled away the money, Al, Kelly, and Bud hold an anti-baby meeting and make plans for a new "Bundy World Order.”

videos.title: Married... With Children
videos.overview: While Jefferson suffers through a sympathetic pregnancy, Peggy is upset that Al is immune. Even worse Buck is listless and getting all the attention due Peggy.

videos.title: Married... With Children
videos.overview: Al keeps barely avoiding minor accidents, so Bud and Kelly try to convince him to get glasses, but he keeps insisting that his vision is perfect.

videos.title: Married... With Children
videos.overview: After Al falls out of his bedroom window and passes out, he claims he saw God's shoes. He decides to make and sell these shoes in order to make it big.

videos.title: Married... With Children
videos.overview: Al finally gets cable TV installed in the Bundy household, but he cannot find anything good to watch. All that changes when Kelly gets her own talk show “Vital Social Issues N’Stuff with Kelly” on public access TV with just $35 from her girlfriends

videos.title: Married... With Children
videos.overview: Al, Kelly, and Bud travel to Hollywood after Kelly's talk show becomes a hit with the TV networks.

videos.title: Married... With Children
videos.overview: Al dreams he's a detective on the verge of a big case.

videos.title: Married... With Children
videos.overview: Peggy sends Bud and Kelly to spy on Al at the shoe store for the day to confirm her suspicion that Al's recent giddiness is the work of an extramarital affair.

videos.title: Married... With Children
videos.overview: Al tries to retrieve his game ball from a former girlfriend after he takes stock of his life and finds he has nothing.

videos.title: Married... With Children
videos.overview: As Grandmaster B, Bud does his coolest best while all over a girl who takes him out to non-traditional Bundy things such as rafting and sky diving. Meanwhile, Al and Peggy invite Marcy and Jefferson over to play a new board game called "Ethical Dilemma."

videos.title: Married... With Children
videos.overview: Al is asked to appear in an athletic shoe commercial. Al, being Polk High's 1966 all-city running back and shoe salesman, is glad to reclaim his glory days
